note: Coal County (FIPS 40029) publishes no zoning district layer. County maps page lists precincts and commissioner districts only; county site has no zoning or GIS service. Coalgate (county seat) site Resources page has no zoning map or GIS link; its City Code is a .docx with no queryable district layer. Zoningatlas Oklahoma page links no Coal County or Coalgate zoning service. ArcGIS search found only a Coal County Data service (cnty/comm/hse/muni boundaries, no zoning). Commercial parcel data with zone fields exists but is paid, not official.
